overview_description.description: ICT Circle is a Dubai-based B2B platform designed for the global ICT (Information and Communication Technology) ecosystem. The platform enables vendors, distributors, resellers, and system integrators to connect, engage, trade, and manage business operations through a unified digital marketplace. It offers a wide range of services including product sourcing, partner networking, lead generation, logistics support, secure payments, escrow services, inventory management, analytics dashboards, and digital marketing tools. ICT Circle aims to modernize the ICT supply chain by providing businesses with a secure and collaborative environment where they can expand globally, discover verified partners, and optimize operational efficiency. The platform also supports AI-powered business insights, shipment verification, insurance assistance, SEO/SMO marketing, and real-time communication tools to help companies improve profitability and customer reach. With its focus on digital transformation and channel ecosystem growth, ICT Circle serves as a comprehensive business enablement platform for IT and technology companies worldwide.

about_short_description.short_description: ICT Circle is a global B2B ICT marketplace and networking platform that connects vendors, distributors, resellers, and system integrators.

product.name: ICT Circle B2B Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform connecting vendors, distributors, resellers, and system integrators in the ICT channel for product listing, buyer-seller matching, and transaction facilitation.

product.name: ICT Assure Services
product.description: A digital service providing credit insurance, secure payment, and risk coverage for transactions within the ICT Circle platform.

product.name: Logistics & Insurance Services
product.description: A cloud-based marketplace connecting buyers and sellers with logistics providers and cargo insurance brokers for shipment procurement and management.

product.name: Business Funding Solutions
product.description: Financial services offered through third-party partners to support trade finance, improve cash flow, and reduce payment risks for ICT channel participants.

product.name: Subscription Plans
product.description: Tiered membership plans offering varying access to platform features such as product listing, lead generation, analytics, and communication tools.

product.name: Partner and Channel Management Tools
product.description: Tools for creating partner circles, managing leads, conducting webinars, and organizing partner events to support ICT channel collaboration and marketing.
